content: I started playing Zenless Zone Zero. It's great. I love it. But I've realized how much it's eating into my conscious awareness. I'm not doing meta thinking anymore. Meditation took a backseat and so did boredom. I feel good but I don't feel real. My tiktok feed dropped me another anchor video that's pulled me back into awareness. I won't stop playing ZZZ but I will stop trying to escape from my own existence
